name: NJM2043 / NJM2043DD
tagline: Low-noise NJM4558 derivative with twice the output current; the noise-screened DD rank targets RIAA preamps.

lineage.note: Low-noise NJM4558 with improved stages, 2x output current. 2018-12-20 4-inch wafer EOL notice reportedly covers it.
Distributors (Octopart, Master Electronics, TrustedParts) list NJM2043D and NJM2043DD under Nisshinbo as discontinued.

part_numbers.note: Base type; datasheet lists DIP8, DMP8 and SIP8 outlines.
DIP8, standard (unscreened) grade. Broker stock may remain.
DIP8 D-rank noise-selected: VNI ≤ 1.4 µV (Rs=2.2 kΩ, RIAA). Retail stock at Akizuki.
DMP8 (SOP-8 type). Discontinued status likely, not individually confirmed.
SIP8. Discontinued status likely, not individually confirmed.
Unconfirmed; only a Jotrin broker listing. Not in the Ver.2003-03-17 package table.

key_specs.value: ≤ 1.4 µV max equivalent input noise (DD rank)

reputation.summary: Praise comes mainly from one Japanese listening comparison (C-Area @WIKI), which rated the NJM2043DD the most pleasing NJM4558-lineage part tested: unusually clear treble for a 4558-type and a fairly flat balance suited to classical. Akizuki sells it as an improved, noise-selected 4558. A Zigsow review disagrees: "コレジャナイ音質" ("not the sound I wanted").
typical_uses: Tone-control and line stages in Japanese gear
DIP8 op-amp rolling in DIY audio
caveats: Praise rests mostly on one hobbyist listening test; a Zigsow reviewer disagrees.
Discontinued: buy reputable stock such as Akizuki, not anonymous marketplaces.
The DD rank differs from the D only by noise screening, not design.

counterfeit_notes: No specific reports, but relabelled 4558-type parts are a plausible risk now it is discontinued. DD shares the D's die, so a remarked D sold as DD is only detectable by measuring noise. Prefer known retail stock such as Akizuki.

corrections: Channels changed from 0 to 2 for all part numbers.
Statuses changed from unknown to discontinued; distributors list NJM2043D and NJM2043DD as discontinued.
NJM2043DD is the D-rank low-noise selected DIP8 (VNI ≤ 1.4 µV, Rs=2.2 kΩ, RIAA), not a package code.
Added NJM2043D (DIP8), NJM2043M (DMP8), NJM2043L (SIP8) and NJM2043S (unconfirmed broker listing).
Filled in specs, datasheet (NJM2043_E Ver.2003-03-17), lineage and alternatives.
Manufacturers separated: New Japan Radio as originator, Nisshinbo Micro Devices as successor.
claims_confirmed: English datasheet 'NJM2043 LOW-NOISE DUAL PRE-AMPLIFIER', Ver.2003-03-17 (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf)
Bipolar low-noise NJM4558 version, 6 V/µs, 14 MHz unity-gain bandwidth, planar epitaxial process (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf)
Operating voltage ±4 V to ±22 V; output current 25 mA (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM2043_E-218482.pdf)
NJM2043DD is noise-selected, VNI ≤ 1.4 µV (Rs=2.2 kΩ, RIAA); improved 4558 stages, about 2x output current (https://akizukidenshi.com/catalog/g/g102369/)

NJM2043D and NJM2043DD discontinued under Nisshinbo (https://octopart.com/part/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/NJM2043DD, https://www.onlinecomponents.com/en/productdetail/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/njm2043d-11971622.html)
